title: TP: kernel fusion + NCCL pipelined overlap + sharded KV cache + continuous-batcher multi-GPU adjustments
author: Asha Patel
release_notes:
- Multi-GPU tensor-parallel: improved communication/computation overlap and tuned NCCL rendezvous to reduce allreduce stalls
- Fused attention and rotary kernel paths for lower per-token compute on 2/4/8 GPU configs
- Sharded KV cache across TP ranks; reduces peak memory and improves throughput for long context workloads
- Continuous batcher aware of TP topology to form GPU-aware microbatches
- No public API breaking changes; rollout gated behind runtime flag
description: Motivation: Production TP workloads for long-context streaming showed two related bottlenecks: (1) NCCL collectives blocking critical compute on some sequence-length distributions, and (2) KV cache memory pressure and locking during continuous batching that forced smaller microbatch sizes. This PR attacks both bottlenecks with a suite of coordinated changes: - NCCL rendezvous tuning and pipelined collectives: introduce a lightweight rendezvous/handshake to align NCCL communicator launches across ranks, add opportunistic async allreduce/p2p windows to overlap with kernel compute, and add per-topology backoff thresholds to avoid cascading retries on temporary GPU bus congestion. - Kernel fusion and scheduling: implement a fused attention+rotary kernel path (CUDA) that reduces memory churn and has a smaller kernel-launch overhead; adjust the TP scheduler to prioritize compute-heavy kernels when collective windows are expected so overlap is maximized. - Sharded KV cache: partition KV storage by TP rank with fast remote prefetch for prefix reuse; replace coarse global locks with per-shard lock-free ring metadata to reduce contention. - Continuous-batcher topology awareness: continuous-batcher now tags microbatches with TP-affinity metadata; the router groups requests to form microbatches that maximize local KV hits and reduce cross-rank synchronization. Backwards-compatible runtime flagged rollout: all changes are gated behind runtime flags (tp_optim.enable and tp_optim.kv_shard) with safe fallbacks to previous behavior. Benchmarks: internal perf harness (see commits) shows +22% throughput on a 4xA100 (32k window) synthetic conversational load and up to 18% p99 latency reduction at 8-GPU TP for mixed sequence-length traces. Also measured ~12% lower GPU memory high-water for long-context inference due to KV sharding. Rollout plan: merge to main behind flags -> enable on canary Dedicated pool -> monitor tp-overlap and KV-hitratio dashboards -> wider rollouts. Checklist: [x] microbench harnesses added [x] unit and integration tests [x] perf regression suite [x] docs/notes added [x] feature gated
commits:
1. refactor: introduce nccl rendezvous manager (asha/nccl-rendezvous)
2. perf: pipelined allreduce window scheduling (asha/pipeline-sched)
3. perf: fused attention+rotary CUDA kernel and kernel registry updates (asha/fused-attn)
4. feature: sharded KV cache with per-shard metadata rings (asha/kv-shard)
5. feature: continuous-batcher TP affinity tagging and router changes (asha/tp-batcher)
6. tests: add tp-overlap integration and bench harness (asha/tests-tp)
7. docs: notes and rollout plan (asha/docs-tp)
review_conversation:
Luca Moretti (reviewer): Can you explain how the rendezvous affects cold-start latency for the first request?
Asha Patel (author): The rendezvous is sub-millisecond on warm runtimes; for cold-start we fall back to the existing communicator bootstrap if handshake times out after 150ms. Added note to docs and a unit test for the timeout.
Priya Banerjee (reviewer): KV sharding looks good but worried about cross-rank prefetch overhead for short requests. Any backpressure?
Asha Patel (author): Router tags microbatches with an affinity threshold. If affinity hit ratio < 0.25 for a group, we avoid cross-rank prefetch and use local fallback. Added a configurable policy and tests.
Diego Sanchez (reviewer): Found a race in metadata_ring on high-concurrency CI run (see inline comment).
Asha Patel (author): Fixed with a publish/consume memory order change and added stress test; reran GPU integration.
Luca Moretti (approver): Verified perf numbers on 4xA100 harness; approving pending CI green.

notes_for_ops: Feature flags: tp_optim.enable=false by default. To enable on a Dedicated pool: set runtime.config.tp_optim.enable=true and toggle tp_optim.kv_shard policy. Monitor dashboards: runtime.tp.overlap_windows, runtime.kv.affinity_hit_ratio, infra.nccl.retries. If increased NCCL retries observed, disable tp_optim.rendezvous_backoff or reduce window sizes.
perf_summary: 4xA100 synthetic conv: +22% throughput (32k window), 8xA100 mixed traces: -18% p99 latency, KV memory high-water -12%
notes: Docs added under docs/notes and examples; no public SDK changes. This PR touches CUDA kernels and low-level collectives: rollouts should proceed with canary gating.
